WFA_help.label: WFA_help
WFA_help.stdout:
usage: skills08 [-h]
                {list,inspect,install,uninstall,status,conflicts,verify} ...

Skills08: Local-First AI Agent Skill Distribution & Lifecycle Manager

positional arguments:
  {list,inspect,install,uninstall,status,conflicts,verify}
                        Available commands
    list                List all candidate skills in catalog
    inspect             Inspect candidate metadata and guidelines
    install             Install a skill package
    uninstall           Uninstall a skill package
    status              Show installed skills and scope status
    conflicts           Check installed skills for conflicts and shadowing
    verify              Verify cryptographic integrity of installed skills

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit

=== Candidate Inspection: security-audit (SKILL08-SEC-001) ===

Display Name:         Codebase Security Audit
Category:             Security
Tier:                 Group A (v0.1)
Operational Model:    Companion-File Guidance Mode
Legal Clearance:      Tier 1: Standard Clearance (MIT)
Author / Maintainer:  Dan Jones / Cloudflare, Inc.
Upstream Repository:  https://github.com/cloudflare/security-audit-skill.git
Locked Commit SHA:    c1c8a8c1471069fb0e188eeaff69b8e8db6564a8
Declared License:     MIT

Description:
  Source-first security guidance and vulnerability review for codebases, APIs, and daemons. Strictly restricted to Guidance Mode on Windows in v0.1 (full audit execution and dynamic target execution disabled; NEEDS-VALIDATION.md used for dynamic verification).

Security Guidelines (D5):
  Guidance Mode Mandatory on Windows. Full audit execution & target scripts disabled. Static exploration only via research subagent.

Adaptation Requirements (D4/D7):
  Relocate entire skills/security-audit/ bundle (SKILL.md, 14 companion markdown playbooks, report-schema.json, and 2 CJS validators) to .agents/skills/security-audit/. Retain flat directory structure to preserve internal relative markdown links. Map subagent roles (research -> read-only codebase exploration subagent; self subagent cannot be used for untrusted code execution). Enforce strict Guidance Mode restriction on Windows: full audit execution is disabled because OS-level cgroups/descriptor sandboxing cannot be enforced; target code execution is strictly prohibited; all dynamic checks must use the built-in NEEDS-VALIDATION.md fallback protocol.

Supporting Files:
  AI-AND-LLM.md, ATTACK-CLASSES.md, CLIENT-SIDE.md, CLOUD-AND-DEPLOYMENT.md, DATA-ISOLATION-AND-LIFECYCLE.md, DESKTOP-MOBILE-AND-LOCAL-IPC.md, HUNTING.md, MEMORY-SAFETY-AND-BINARY.md, PROTOCOLS-RPC-AND-MESSAGING.md, RECONNAISSANCE.md, RESOURCE-EXHAUSTION-AND-AVAILABILITY.md, SUPPLY-CHAIN-AND-RELEASE.md, VALIDATION-AND-REPORTING.md, WEB-PROTOCOL-AND-AUTH.md, report-schema.json, validate-findings.cjs, validate-coverage-ledger.cjs

=== Skills08 Conflict & Shadowing Analysis ===

Detected 2 ecosystem interaction issue(s):

[1] CON-001: Aesthetic Persona & Design Token Incompatibility (Severity: Medium)
    Category: Capability Overlap & Token Collision
    Details:  Multiple competing frontend design skills are simultaneously active: unslop, hallmark. Unscoped co-loading may introduce conflicting styling heuristics and prompt bloat.
    Mitigation: Follow D7 REC-SYS-006: Scope skills by workflow phase — 'unslop' for pre-commit critique, 'hallmark' for component micro-polish, 'design-taste-frontend' for design system tokens, 'impeccable' for holistic UX direction.

[2] CON-011: Cross-Repository Lexical Collision: hallmark (Severity: Medium)
    Category: Naming & Discovery
    Details:  Skill name 'hallmark' appears across multiple distinct upstream repositories (hallmark, open-design). Flat installation without namespacing causes collisions.
    Mitigation: Install canonical single-origin package curated by Skills08.
